449:t_3:42.en:
$$アスカ$$
「...Your true form is being a total airhead.」

449:t_3:43.en:
$$カレン$$
「That's going too far, $$アスカ$$!」

449:t_3:44.en:
$$チコ$$
「It's fine, $$カレン$$. She's exactly right.」

449:t_3:45.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Then that thing called the $$地球帝国宇宙軍$$...」

449:t_3:46.en:
$$ノノ$$
「That also just sort of came up from the bottom of my head. I don't really understand what it means, either...」

449:t_3:48.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The $$地球帝国宇宙軍$$... Isn't that the military of the world $$ノリコ$$ came from?」

449:t_3:49.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Yeah... That's why I thought there might be some connection, but...」

449:t_3:50.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$バスターマシン７号$$ is nothing like my $$ガンバスター$$ either, so I guess they're unrelated after all.」

449:t_3:51.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「It seems our world and the world of $$ノリコ$$ and the others sit relatively close to each other among the parallel worlds.」

449:t_3:52.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Anyway! $$ノノ$$ set out to get her hands on a $$バスターマシン$$, but magnificently, she has become a $$バスターマシン$$ herself!」

449:t_3:54.en:
$$アルト$$
「It's probably a waste of breath to call her out on it...」

449:t_3:55.en:
$$ノノ$$
「With this, $$ノノ$$ has come one more step closer to $$ノノリリ$$! Please look forward to all of $$ノノ$$'s exploits from here on!」

449:t_3:56.en:
$$カレン$$
「I'll admit it's an amazing power, sure, but...」

449:t_3:57.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「And here I thought we'd finally learn the secret of the $$宇宙怪獣|lc$$...」

449:t_3:58.en:
$$チコ$$
「It was pointless to expect anything from $$ノノ$$ in the first place.」

449:t_3:59.en:
$$宗介$$
「Everyone, dismissed. We're heading out on our next mission.」

449:t_3:60.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Please wait a moment! I did figure out a little about the $$バスター軍団$$!」

449:t_3:62.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「You mean the Solar System-limited kind?」

449:t_3:63.en:
$$ノノ$$
「That's right. They must have been... looking for $$ノノ$$.」

449:t_3:64.en:
$$ノノ$$
「And on top of that, I think some small mix-up led to the fighting.」

449:t_3:66.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I can't explain it well, but I think the real enemy of the $$バスター軍団$$ is the $$宇宙怪獣|lc$$.」

449:t_3:67.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I don't know if that means the $$宇宙怪獣|lc$$ of $$ノリコ$$'s world, but in any case, the enemy is the $$宇宙怪獣|lc$$!」

449:t_3:68.en:
$$ラルク$$
「So you're saying we'd been mistaking the enemy of the $$宇宙怪獣|lc$$ for $$宇宙怪獣|lc$$?」

449:t_3:69.en:
$$チコ$$
「Can't be helped, right? In fact, that $$バスター軍団$$ did come at humanity, after all.」

449:t_3:70.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Are you saying they mistook humanity for $$宇宙怪獣|lc$$...?」

449:t_3:71.en:
$$甲児$$
「...That's a little hard to imagine.」

449:t_3:72.en:
$$ノノ$$
「But it's all right now. $$ノノ$$ has properly told everyone about the true enemy!」

449:t_3:76.en:
$$チコ$$
「Well, it's you saying it... Looks like nobody can quite bring themselves to trust it.」

449:t_3:78.en:
$$ラルク$$
「But the fact remains that the $$バスター軍団$$ and $$ノノ$$ helped me.」

449:t_3:80.en:
$$ノノ$$
「If I can hear those words from you, Big Sis, $$ノノ$$ is completely satisfied!」

449:t_3:81.en:
$$勝平$$
「This ain't the time to get all warm and fuzzy! That $$堕天翅$$ called $$ミカゲ$$ is closing in on $$蒼の地球$$!」

449:t_3:82.en:
$$宗介$$
「That's right. We sortie again right away.」

449:t_3:83.en:
$n
「I'm counting on you, $$ノノ$$. Let's see what you can do as a $$バスターマシン$$.」

449:t_3:86.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Exactly that... $$ノノ$$ doesn't really know how she turns into $$バスターマシン７号$$, either.」

449:t_3:88.en:
$$アルト$$
「It's gotten to the point where I'm too stunned to say anything...」

449:t_3:91.en:
$$赤木$$
「In short, your motivation turned out to be the key to reviving $$バスターマシン７号$$, so what matters is fighting spirit.」

449:t_3:93.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「That's right, $$ノノ$$! Let's fight with hard work, guts, and fighting spirit!」

449:t_3:94.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Hearing that gives me 100 times the courage!」

449:t_3:95.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I'll board $$ＥＶＯ－４$$ when we sortie, like always, but once things get fired up, I'm sure I'll be able to become $$バスターマシン７号$$.」

449:t_3:96.en:
$n
「I'll be counting on you, just in case.」

449:t_3:97.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Ah, $n! You transform $$ジェニオン$$ into $$ジェミニオン・レイ$$ with fighting spirit yourself, and that's how you put it!?」

449:t_3:98.en:
$n
「Now that you mention it, you're right...」

449:t_3:99.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「You're all about hard work, guts, and fighting spirit too, $n.」

449:t_3:101.en:
$$アルト$$
「You finally stopped being the quiet type, just like you wanted. Show a little more joy, will you?」

449:t_3:103.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Your smile is stiff! You'll never get through the battles ahead like that!」

449:t_3:104.en:
$$ラルク$$
「All right, I get it, so let's go, $$ノノ$$. The enemy won't wait for us.」

449:t_3:106.en:
$$ラルク$$
(Now $$ノノ$$ will never disappear from in front of me again... Now we can fight together forever, can't we...)

449:t_10:6.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Showing a face like that, how could I leave it alone? Tell me about it.」

449:t_10:7.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「...When I fought in tandem with $$ノノ$$, it reminded me of Big Sis...」

449:t_10:8.en:
$$ラルク$$
「The person who rode the $$ガンバスター$$ with you, huh...」

449:t_10:9.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「It's faded now, but this is a photo of Big Sis.」

449:t_10:12.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「She's not just beautiful, she's kind and strong and dignified... She's my idol, always and forever.」

449:t_10:15.en:
$$ラルク$$
「We're both called 'Big Sis,' but she's very different from me... is what I was thinking.」

449:t_10:16.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$ラルク$$ is a fine Big Sis to $$ノノ$$. Even today, $$ノノ$$ could fight almost entirely because $$ラルク$$ was there.」

地球帝国宇宙軍.evidence: Organization of Noriko's (Gunbuster) world named in Buster Machine No. 7's self-introduction (450:t_017:5, Earth Empire Space Force, Solar System Direct Defense Unit) and by Noriko/Kamille/Nono here; not in the glossary, literal rendering of 地球+帝国+宇宙軍.

kept_omissions: 449:t_3:72: みんな kept as 'everyone' (Nono told 'everyone' about the true enemy; likely the Buster Legion/Buster Machines, but rows 75-76 show the pilots reacting, so left open).
uncertain: 449:t_3:45/48 etc.: 地球帝国宇宙軍 has no glossary entry; proposed token $$地球帝国宇宙軍$$ = 'Earth Empire Space Force' (literal; slice dlg_2062_05 has the same term in Buster Machine No. 7's intro and should match).
449:t_3:44: 'She's exactly right' - Tycho agrees with Asuka's insult of Nono (referent settled by scene).
449:t_3:68: 宇宙怪獣の敵を宇宙怪獣だと思い込んでた read as 'we mistook the space monsters' enemy (the Buster Legion) for space monsters'; 宇宙怪獣 rendered with |lc as generic plural.
449:t_3:62/66/67: 太陽系限定種 = 'Solar System-limited kind' to match dlg_2062_01/dlg_2060_04 (no wiki check).
449:t_3:96: 一応 rendered 'just in case' (Hibiki teasing that Nono's power is unreliable).
449:t_3:101: 脱ムッツリ = 'stopped being the quiet type' per settled list; 念願 = 'just like you wanted'.
449:t_10:7-16: Noriko's お姉さま (Kazumi) = 'Big Sis' so row 15 (Lal'C: 'both called Big Sis') works; may be confused with Lal'C in row 7 until the photo row.
449:t_3:94: 勇気１００倍 = '100 times the courage'; 気合 = 'fighting spirit' throughout.
